usageNotes: Use this to retrieve the current configuration of a specific PDM user — their display name, email, enabled state, and expiration. The caller must hold System.Audit on /access/users or be reading their own account (the userid path param matches the authenticated identity). The userid must be in user@realm format (e.g. admin@pam); supplying only a username without a realm will fail validation.

examples.summary: Fetch configuration for the built-in admin account

tips: A returned 'enable: false' means the account is disabled and cannot authenticate — useful for auditing stale or locked-out accounts.
The 'expire' field is a Unix epoch integer; value 0 means the account never expires.
API tokens (allowtoken: true) can call this endpoint, making it safe to use from automation without a full session ticket.
